name: bg-animate-button
title: Animated Gradient Button
description: Three rounded pill buttons sit on black, filled with turning orange, pale blue and violet gradients. The colour sweeps around inside each pill while the bold label stays still.
use: A hero needs bright, colourful calls to action that stand out on a dark background.
avoid: Light fills force dark label text, and each colour is a fixed preset rather than a free colour.
a11y: Native buttons keep their focus ring, but the spin never pauses for reduced-motion users. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three rounded pill buttons sit in a row on black, one orange-red, one pale blue and one violet, each darker toward its edges. Labels are bold dark text, except on the violet pill where it is white.
behaves: Each pill's conic gradient turns slowly inside the frame, so light sweeps around it while the shape and label hold still. The three run at their own speeds.
customise: The label comes in as children; gradient preset, animation speed, rounding, size and shadow are props. A new colour needs a new preset in the source.
weight: light: Three CSS spin animations on gradient spans; no script and no canvas.
